current_evidence: The council's 'Guidance, checklists and advice notes' page links the per-application-type checklists, including the 'Validation Checklist and Guidance - Proposals for Planning Permission' that Grokbot used. The council also publishes a 'Local Validation Summary' (Version 0.1, https://huntingdonshire.gov.uk/media/4floiins/local-validation-summary.pdf) mapping each local requirement to application types. No checklist or page text shows an adoption or publication date.

issues.detail: Householder has only Flood Risk Assessment, but the Householder checklist also requires: Access Plan (new access proposed); Biodiversity and Geodiversity checklist, with a PEA if any answer is yes (all applications); Heritage Statement (heritage asset affected, including in a conservation area); Site sections and finished floor/site levels (levels differ or development within 300mm of the boundary); Roof plans (all except where the building is unchanged); Trees, Woodland, Hedges and Hedgerows Assessment and Tree Protection Plan (trees on or adjacent to the site); Design and Access Statement (conservation area and 1+ dwelling or 100m2+). Two of these (Biodiversity Checklist, Floor plans) were taken from the householder PDF but filed under Full planning instead.
issues.evidence: 'Validation Checklist and Guidance - Householder Application...' (media/5517/application-householder.pdf); Local Validation Summary column HH

issues.detail: The Full planning column omits many items in the 'Proposals for Planning Permission' checklist: Flood Risk Assessment (1ha+ in Flood Zone 1; any development in Flood Zones 2/3); Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment; Biodiversity Statement (no net loss) and Biodiversity Audit (50+ dwellings or 2ha+); Developer Contributions Draft Heads of Terms (over 10 homes); Economic Statement; Ground Contamination/Groundwater Pollution Investigation; Groundwater Protection (Source Protection Zone or within 50m of a private potable source); Rapid HIA (50+ dwellings/2ha+) and Full HIA (200+ dwellings); Landscaping Details; Noise Impact Assessment; Open Space Assessment; Parking Provision; Planning/Supporting Statement (all); Retail Sequential/Impact Assessment (600m2+ outside centres); Sustainability Statement (all major); Telecommunications information; Transport Statement; Wastewater Management and Utilities Assessment (major, new sewer connection or Amber/Red capacity). The Local Validation Summary also lists LVIA, Needs Assessment and Policy Checklist for PP/OPP.
issues.evidence: Proposals for Planning Permission checklist items 7-9, 13, 14, 18, 20-25, 27-31, 35-38, 43; Local Validation Summary items 13, 17, 26-29, 31, 36, 44, 50

issues.detail: Listed building consent omits LBC-specific local items: Schedule of Works and/or Specification of Repairs; Windows/Shopfront Survey; Building sections/finished floor levels; Heritage Statement (the most obvious LBC requirement); Biodiversity Checklist. Variation of condition s73 shows 'none' although Grokbot read the council's removal/variation checklist (media/5515/application-for-removal-or-variation.pdf).
issues.evidence: Local Validation Summary items 15, 25, 39, 51 (column LBC); docs_read includes application-for-removal-or-variation.pdf

issues.detail: The Outline list was copied wholesale into Reserved matters. The Local Validation Summary limits these to PP/OPP, not RM: Affordable Housing Statement, Agricultural dwelling appraisal, Air Quality, Archaeological Assessment, BNG, Environmental Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Health Impact Assessment, Retail Sequential/Impact, Statement of Community Involvement, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan and Structural Survey are all listed against RM only through this copy, sourced from the outline PDF.
issues.evidence: Local Validation Summary, e.g. '7 Affordable Housing Statement - PP, OPP'; '46 Transport Assessment - PP, OPP'

issues.detail: Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named' although the source document is titled 'Proposals for Planning Permission', so the type is explicit. 'Noise Impact Assessment' is placed under LBC using text from the full-planning PDF's Lighting Assessment ('listed building or a conservation area... where external lighting'); the summary does not apply noise assessment to LBC. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' under LBC comes from the householder PDF.
issues.evidence: Checklist title 'Validation Checklist and Guidance - Proposals for Planning Permission'; Local Validation Summary '32 Noise Impact Assessment - PP, OPP, RM'

issues.detail: Many triggers are misattributed or garbled. Health Impact Assessment (Outline/RM) shows the Heritage Statement trigger ('Where the significance of any heritage asset is affected'); the actual trigger is 50+ dwellings/2ha+ (Rapid) or 200+ (Full). Noise Impact Assessment shows 'Rapid HIA as per policy Full HIA...'. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan show 'Usually required for applications involving demolition or conversion', which is the Structural Survey trigger; the actual trigger is 50+ dwellings, 80+ for a Residential Travel Plan, or high HGV movements. Heritage Statement starts 'OR Within 50m of a private potable groundwater source'. Air Quality (Full) is form text ('as an Air Quality Assessment ☐ ☐ Click or tap here to enter text.'); the actual trigger is 200+ dwellings or within 50m of an AQMA/Clean Air Zone. BNG = 'the DEFRA Biodiversity Metric.'; Highways = 'site including access arrangements'.
issues.evidence: Proposals for Planning Permission checklist: Air Quality '200+ dwellings, or site in or within 50m of an AQMA'; Rapid HIA '50+ dwellings or 2ha+'

issues.detail: The list date 2024-02-01 comes from PDF metadata only. Neither the checklists, the guidance page nor the Local Validation Summary (Version 0.1) states an adoption or publication date, so the date cannot be confirmed from document text.
issues.evidence: Guidance page: no adopted/updated date; only footer '(c) Huntingdonshire District Council 2026'

issues.detail: Some rows are guidance, not requirements: LBC 'Photographs provide helpful supplementary information...' (optional); 'Pre-application'/CIL explanatory text ('The introduction of the levy means that charging authorities...') used as the CIL trigger; SCI 'may be appropriate' for majors.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts for Photographs (LBC) and CIL Additional Information (Full planning)

issues.detail: Grokbot did not use the council's Local Validation Summary, which gives an explicit requirement-to-application-type matrix (PP, OPP, RM, HH, LBC, LDC, AC) and would have avoided the INFERRED placements.
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

summary: Grokbot used the right set of current per-type checklists, but its extraction is badly incomplete: Householder has only 1 of about 10 local items, and Full planning misses about 20, including Flood Risk Assessment and HIA. It also copied Outline-only items into Reserved matters and has many garbled or misattributed triggers. No adoption date appears in any source text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
